newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves through overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves through overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added temporary reserves to the banking system on Tuesday through overnight system repurchase agreements, a Fed spokesman said.
The add move was in line with expectations.

By 1030 EST/1530 GMT, the federal funds rate was quoted at 5-7/16 percent, well above the central bank's 5-1/4 percent target. The upward pressure on the rate was seen as the reason why the Fed entered the market about one hour earlier than its usual 1130 EST/1630 GMT intervention time, analysts said.
Analysts added a coupon pass is still widely expected to take place later on Tuesday. -- NA Treasury Desk, 212-859-1676
